summary.ko: 다섯 단계 중 활성 경로의 신호만 이동하고 나머지는 중간 지점에 둡니다.
summary.en: Moves only the active signal across five steps while other signals hold at their midpoints.

sourceTimeline.description: Five source steps run across one 2,400ms ambient pass. activeStepIdx=floor(progress×steps.length); localT=(progress×steps.length)%1; active dot interpolates fromX→toX, idle dots stay at 0.5.
